searchText: The complexity of the merge mostly comes from the consensus swap. Which involves a new type of client and related infrastructure changes, shift in the community caused by re-understanding how does Ethereum work, some technical changes in opcodes and sync algorithm, communication protocol between eth1 and eth2 nodes, etc. The beacon chain part of the work is relatively easy to do. What is the benefit of making it even more simple? Btw, why would we need the coinbase field in Validator record? Why validator wouldn't just pass the address to the coinbase in Eth1 block?
